description: Sputnik’s opened Feb 1 report verifies two separate Bishkek gatherings: Caravan sellers and Sadovoye residents; it gives no turnout for either. A Kloop headline advertises a third gathering, with the labor-federation report retained as search-only lead E003. Keep the two verified groups distinct and do not infer a 50-person crowd.
required_followup: Verify each candidate’s turnout with a separately gated contemporaneous source; resolve the third reported gathering, its target/demand and whether it was a separate action.

description: Search headers identify a pasture-dispute rally in Naryn on or around Feb 2; participant number, precise date, government target and release demand are unverified.
required_followup: Fresh-gate and read contemporaneous reports; keep the event pending unless size and own-state target are evidenced.

description: Search headers identify Feb 5 Osh Bazaar traders gathering at the Government House; actual participant count and the specific state-directed work/infrastructure demands remain unverified.
required_followup: Fresh-gate at least one original contemporaneous report; establish turnout, demands, route, response and end.

description: Search headers identify a Feb 7 Sunday “For Legality” march, but turnout and any relation to the recurring series are unverified.
required_followup: Read the individual dated report; never transfer another week’s count or assume series unit.

description: Several reports point to a Feb 14 Bishkek justice/anti-corruption march; reports may share RFE/RL origin. Headline-level evidence does not settle turnout, demands, route, response, end, or weekly-episode unit.
required_followup: Fresh-gate primary contemporaneous reports; compare attributed counts and written origins without counting syndicated copies independently.

description: A SerepKG headline mentions Feb 14 demonstrations in Bishkek and Batken; it may refer to another gathering but place, group, size, demand and article scope have not been checked.
required_followup: Inspect the video/article with a fresh gate or retain as an unresolved search-only lead.

description: Azattyk and 24.kg search results point to border-area residents protesting in Bishkek on Feb 15 and a second rally Feb 16. The Feb 15 result is reported elsewhere as roughly 30; verify the separate days, counts, demands, end and state engagement without transferring a count.
required_followup: Read the Feb 15 and Feb 16 reports separately and determine whether each physical assembly reaches 50; preserve the cross-day relation.

description: Feb 19 search-result headlines identify Matraimov-support rallies in Kara-Suu and Bishkek; another headline lists Osh too. Location-specific turnout, release demands, state target and whether there were one or several actions remain unresolved.
required_followup: Read local reports for each place; do not merge or split the coordinated actions without evidence and do not treat names/counts at one place as another’s.

description: Search-result material suggests a Feb 21 Bishkek Sunday “For Legality” march and an archive for the recurring series. Actual event body, turnout and episode unit are not yet established.
required_followup: Find and gate the individual Feb 21 report; no count transfer from Feb 7, 14 or 28.

description: Feb 28 search results identify an Osh rally supporting Matraimov and opposing Radio Azattyk, with widely diverging crowd estimates reported in discovery leads. Turnout, written origin, demands, target and event end need body-level review.
required_followup: Read contemporary Osh reports and the crowd-estimate fact check; preserve each attribution and avoid combining incompatible estimates.

description: An Azattyk search result published around Feb 28 mentions an Osh rally and Bishkek activists; it may describe the local Sunday march that day, but the headline alone does not verify that.
required_followup: Read the report and any individual Bishkek march source; determine whether it describes a Feb 28 assembly and its own size.

description: Open-web searches across English, Russian, Kyrgyz and local/regional outlets surfaced these leads, but do not establish no other gatherings occurred. LexisNexis is not reproduced; less-indexed district, workplace and Kyrgyz-language coverage may be missing. The official baseline and its universe remain pending.
required_followup: Continue targeted local/regional and retrospective searches, then report residual coverage limits; await coordinator’s official-baseline reconciliation.
